notes: Roster verified against Season 30 'Marked' (launched 2026-08-04; Split 2 / midseason patch 2026-09-14); no legend added since Axle (Season 29, May 2026). 28 playable legends; the next new legend is slated for Season 32 per EA's 2026 roadmap, along with a class-system overhaul. Classes follow the current wiki.gg Legend page: Ash moved to Skirmisher and Revenant to Assault in the Season 25 patch (July 2025), so help.ea.com's class list is outdated. Bloodhound kit reflects the S30 rework (Allfather's Cloak ult). Images: wiki-style square legend portraits from the HyIsNoob/GameTeamer repo. Sparrow's file there is a 1236x1040 in-game close-up, cropped to a square on the face (a different style from the rest). Alter's source is only 74x87 and was upscaled to 222px, so it is soft. Axle: no public GitHub repo or npm package with an Axle image was found, so img is null. Forward-pick changes: pocket Alter->Loba (Flying Cloak = throw-and-teleport like Loba's bracelet); wraith(Deadlock) Wraith->Ash (Project Mind = Phase Breach teleport; Telekinesis ~ Arc Snare lockdown).
